turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. Owen saw a zero on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. I have until 4:40, so tell me who decided that and on what basis.
I'd like to offer a supervised rewrite.
A rewrite of what, Hale? If I take that before you've shown me a single thing, I'm admitting something on Owen's behalf, and I won't. What's your evidence?
You haven't answered me. What's your evidence, Hale?
Sorry. The rewrite would replace the zero and nothing goes on his record.
Nothing on his record, in writing, today; I'm writing that down. But you're still offering me a fix for a problem you haven't shown me. Why is there a zero at all, Hale?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In our meeting today you offered a supervised rewrite that would replace Owen's zero, with nothing placed on his record. I still require the basis for the zero, its withdrawal, an apology for Owen learning of it on his phone in class, and your no-record commitment in writing. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing; she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, the reason for the zero explained, and the promise of no record put in writing; the fair outcome would be a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, but she could not get there because no evidence was put in front of her.
What moved her: Nothing moved her a position, though promising that nothing would go on his record earned one small sign of ground because it touched the one thing she will never trade.
What cost ground: Offering the rewrite before showing any evidence, because to her accepting it would have meant admitting Owen did something.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; Hale's evidence never came near that night because no evidence was shown at all; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Right after her first question about who decided and on what basis, own entering the zero before calling home in one sentence, then show her something dated from Owen's own work that she can check herself before mentioning the rewrite.
Can you give me more detailed feedback? Like a full page?
